items.q: O.-C., when O.-C. was with her, O.-C. used to catch us looking at each other silent, and O.-C. always used to take her and split.

ctx.x: her and we would always look at each other. There was always a look. And O.-C., when O.-C. was with her, O.-C. used to catch us looking at each other silent, and O.-C. always used to take her and split.
Yeah. He'd take her and split.
